data.description: Modern Studio Living | Prime Location | Spacious
data.long_description:
Description:
  Discover modern urban living in this stylish studio apartment, perfectly designed for comfort and functionality. Spanning 473.07 sq. ft., this thoughtfully laid-out unit offers a bright open-plan living space complemented by large windows that invite natural light throughout the day. The contemporary interiors feature high-quality finishes, sleek flooring, and a well-appointed kitchen fitted with modern cabinetry and premium fittings, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining.


  The living and sleeping area is intelligently arranged to maximize space, creating a cozy yet elegant environment. A well-designed bathroom adds to the convenience, finished with quality fixtures and a clean, modern aesthetic. This studio is perfect for individuals or professionals seeking a practical home in a vibrant community.


  Features:
  • Studio Apartment
  • Size: 473.07 Sq. Ft.
  • Open-Plan Layout
  • Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
  • Modern Kitchen with Built-in Cabinets
  • High-Quality Finishes
  • Built-in Wardrobes
  • Elegant Bathroom
  • Bright and Spacious Interior


  Amenities:
  • Swimming Pool
  • Fully Equipped Gym
  • 24/7 Security
  • Covered Parking
  • High-Speed Elevators
  • Lobby & Reception Area
  • Retail & Dining Options Nearby
  • Easy Access to Main Roads and Transport


  Ideal for comfortable city living, this property offers convenience, style, and accessibility in one perfect package.
